analysis: CRIMSON ABYSS — a top-tier Extreme Demon (~4 min) inspired by Bloodbath / Bloodlust. 13 sections, each commits to one gamemode and pace; difficulty escalates from a sparse cube intro through ship / ball / wave / UFO / dual / robot / spider / swing gauntlets to a brutal triple-speed cube climax and a melodic outro. Decoration budget is ~35%: dim background gears & clouds at z=-3..-5, pulsing diamonds/stars/hearts on the beat, color shifts at every section boundary, screen-shake on the drop & climax. Palette is dark crimson with neon scarlet + ember accents. Hard but fair — every obstacle has a telegraph via a paired orb, pad, or visual cue.
